faq_heading: Homes near Douglas Park Community: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Douglas Park Community catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Douglas Park Community home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Douglas Park Community, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Douglas Park Community sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 209 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,045,000, townhomes $604,000, condos $461,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Douglas Park Community?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Douglas Park Community the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 96.6% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 209 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Douglas Park Community?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (0.6 km north), Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (0.6 km south) and Nicomekl Elementary (1.1 km west).

How the Douglas Park Community search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Douglas Park Community, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Douglas Park Community sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 209 homes sold within 1 km of Douglas Park Community: 13 houses, 28 townhomes and 168 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $461,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Douglas Park Community

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Douglas Park Community in a straight line (9 elementary, 5 secondary, 4 other, 1 middle; 4 independent). The closest is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Latimer Road Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (0.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (0.6 km south), Nicomekl Elementary (1.1 km west), Simonds Elementary (1.6 km south-west), Uplands Elementary (2.0 km south), Murrayville Academy (2.2 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary, 0.6 km south of Douglas Park Community.
